## Frequently asked questions

### Are electric dirt bikes legal to ride in Australia?

Electric dirt bikes like the Sur-Ron Light Bee X, Talaria Sting R, and Stark Varg are purpose-built high-power competition off-road vehicles. They are 100% legal on private property, designated off-road motocross parks, and private bush tracks across Australia without registration. Dual-sport models equipped with ADR lighting kits can be registered depending on state transport rules (NSW TfNSW, VicRoads, QLD TMR).

### How does the 10% Crypto Discount work at checkout?

When you choose Crypto (Bitcoin, USDT, or Ethereum) or instant PayID, a 10% discount is automatically deducted from your order subtotal. You will receive an instant order summary with exact transfer instructions, and your bike is queued for priority dispatch once confirmed.

### How are electric dirt bikes shipped across Australia?

Every bike is packaged inside a heavy-duty steel-reinforced transport crate with custom foam brackets to eliminate transit damage. We dispatch Aus-wide via specialized tailgate freight carriers directly from our Southern Highlands NSW 2575 warehouse. Delivery is 100% FREE on all bike orders over $1,500 AUD.

### What warranty is included with my purchase?

All bikes and battery packs sold by Electric Dirt Bike Australia include a 12-Month Comprehensive Australian Factory Warranty covering the frame, motor, controller, battery, and electrical harness against manufacturer defects. We stock genuine replacement parts locally in NSW for rapid turnaround.

### How do I maintain the battery and get the best lifespan?

Store your lithium battery in a dry place between 15°C and 25°C. Avoid leaving the battery at 0% charge for extended periods. For seasonal storage, keep the battery around 50-60% charge and top it up every 60 days. Our smart fast chargers feature automated cutoffs to prevent overcharging.

### How fast does a Sur-Ron Light Bee X go?

The Sur-Ron Light Bee X has a top speed of approximately 75 km/h in unrestricted mode. The motor controller can be software-tuned for slower speeds, making it suitable for younger riders on private property. With aftermarket 72V battery upgrades and a reprogrammed controller, experienced riders can reach 90–95 km/h on smooth terrain.

### How fast does a Talaria Sting R MX4 go?

The Talaria Sting R MX4 reaches a top speed of approximately 85 km/h from its 60V 45Ah sealed gearbox drivetrain. Its 8kW peak motor output provides stronger hill-climbing torque compared to belt-drive models, and its IPX7-rated sealed gearbox handles mud, creek crossings, and technical rocky terrain that would damage belt systems.

### How much does an electric dirt bike cost in Australia?

Entry-level electric dirt bikes for kids start from $3,690 AUD. Mid-range adult performance bikes like the Sur-Ron Light Bee X are $6,490 AUD and the Talaria Sting R MX4 is $7,290 AUD. High-performance motocross bikes like the Stark Varg EX 80HP are $18,990 AUD. All prices include GST and free Australia-wide delivery on orders over $1,500.

### Do I need a licence to ride an electric dirt bike in Australia?

No motorcycle licence is required to ride an electric dirt bike on private property, farmland, or enclosed off-road parks in Australia. A standard motorcycle licence (R class) is required if you wish to ride on public roads. Contact your state transport authority (NSW TfNSW, VicRoads, Qld TMR, DPTI SA) for exact registration and licensing requirements for road-legal variants.

### How long does the battery last on one charge?

Battery range depends on rider weight, terrain, and riding style. The Sur-Ron Light Bee X delivers 40–65 km per charge on mixed trail riding. The Talaria Sting R MX4 provides 60–90 km per charge with its larger 60V 45Ah pack. The Stark Varg EX 80HP achieves 35–50 km per charge during full-race intensity motocross riding. Relaxed trail and bush riding can extend range by 30–50%.

### What is the best electric dirt bike for adults in Australia?

For most adult riders, the Sur-Ron Light Bee X is the best all-round choice — lightweight at 50 kg, highly modifiable, and priced at $6,490. Riders wanting more torque and gearbox durability prefer the Talaria Sting R MX4 at $7,290. Competitive motocross and enduro riders choose the Stark Varg EX 80HP or E-Ride Pro SR for maximum power.

### Can kids ride electric dirt bikes in Australia?

Yes — Electric Dirt Bike Australia stocks a junior range starting from age 3. The Segway X160 Compact ($4,690) suits riders aged 10–15. The Torrot Motocross Two Junior ($3,690) is ideal for younger children 6–12. All junior models include speed-limit modes adjustable via the app or controller, making them safe for supervised private property riding.

### Is there GST included in the displayed price?

Yes. All prices displayed on our website are inclusive of 10% Australian Goods and Services Tax (GST). You will receive a full tax invoice with your ABN and GST breakdown with every order, suitable for business expense claims or SMSF records.

#### E Bike Battery Guide: Voltage, Amp Hours and Range

An e bike battery is defined by voltage and amp hours. Voltage sets power, and amp hours set range: a 72V 40Ah pack stores roughly 2.9kWh. Match the pack to your controller and the bike's connector before you buy.

#### E Cycle Battery and Replacement Packs

An e cycle battery pack that has lost capacity can be replaced with a new lithium pack in the same voltage. Check the controller's maximum voltage first, and use a charger matched to the pack.

#### Batteries for Electric Bicycles: Compatibility

Batteries for electric bicycles are not interchangeable. Voltage, connector, form factor and the battery management system must match your bike. Contact us with your bike model and we will confirm the correct pack.

**How much is an electric bicycle battery replacement?** Replacement cost depends on voltage and capacity. See the packs on this page for current pricing, and read our battery replacement cost guide.

**Do you sell e bike batteries and chargers together?** Yes. Packs and matched chargers are listed here, and free freight applies over $1,500.

**Can I get an e bike battery charger separately?** Yes, chargers are sold separately. Choose one that matches your pack voltage and connector.

#### Charger for E Bike: Fast and Standard Chargers

A charger for an e bike must match the pack voltage and connector. Standard 3A to 5A chargers suit overnight charging, while 10A and 15A fast chargers cut a 72V pack to a few hours. Fast charging is convenient but runs the battery warmer, so keep it for when you need it.

### Electric Bike Laws Australia: Are E-Bikes Legal? NSW, VIC, QLD & WA 2026

URL: https://electricdirtbikeaustralia.com.au/electric-motor-bikes/e-bike-laws-australia/
Summary: Electric bike laws Australia 2026: power limits, age rules and certification for NSW, QLD, VIC and WA, plus what is road legal.

#### Electric Bike Laws Australia: What to Check Before You Ride

Pedal-assist e-bikes that meet the Australian standard (250W continuous power and a 25 km/h assist limit) are treated as bicycles. Anything more powerful is a motor vehicle on public roads and needs registration and a licence.

Rules differ by state, so use the sections below for your state and check the official source before you ride.

#### Electric Bike Laws QLD

Queensland follows the national standard for pedal-assist bikes: 250W continuous power and a 25 km/h assist cutoff. Higher-powered bikes are treated as motor vehicles on public roads and need registration and a licence.

#### Electric Bike Regulations NSW and Certification

New South Wales uses the same 250W and 25 km/h standard. Bikes must meet the Australian standard to be sold and ridden as bicycles, and our e-bikes that carry this status need no registration. Read the NSW regulations guide for the detail.

#### E Bike Laws Victoria: Age Limit

Victoria allows pedal-assist e-bikes that meet the 250W standard to be ridden without a licence, with the rider age and helmet rules that apply to bicycles. Higher-powered bikes need registration.

#### Street Legal Electric Bike: What Qualifies

A street legal electric bike either meets the bicycle standard or is registered as a motor vehicle. Road-registered electric mopeds qualify; off-road electric dirt bikes do not, whatever the seller says.

**What is a road legal electric bike?** A road legal electric bike meets the 250W and 25 km/h bicycle standard, or is a registered electric moped or motorcycle. Off-road dirt bikes are not road legal.

**Are road legal dirt bikes available as electric?** Electric dirt bikes are off-road only unless the model has road registration. Road-registered options are the electric mopeds and electric motorcycles.

**Can I get a road registered electric bike?** Yes, our electric mopeds and some motorcycles are road registered, which makes them a road registered electric bike in the legal sense. Check each product page for registration details.

**What is the e bike laws Victoria age limit?** Age rules depend on bike type and rider. The Victoria Police e-bike safety page is the official source, and we recommend checking it before buying a bike for a teenager.

**Do I need a licence for an e-bike in Victoria?** Not for a pedal-assist e-bike that meets the 250W and 25 km/h standard. Registered electric mopeds and motorbikes do need a licence.

**What are the WA ebike laws?** Western Australia follows the same national standard for bicycle-class e-bikes. See the [WA Road Safety Commission](https://www.wa.gov.au/organisation/road-safety-commission/bicycle-riders) for current rules.

### E Bike Battery Guide: Voltage, Amp Hours, Range & Care

**What is a motor bicycle battery, and is it the same as an e-bike pack?** People use that phrase for a lot of things, including the 12V starter battery in a petrol motorcycle. **What affects e-bike electric range apart from battery size?** Weight, tyres, terrain, assist level, speed and temperature all play a part. Use watt hours divided by your own consumption in Wh per kilometre. Log a few rides, work out your average, and you will have a far better estimate than any brochure figure.

### E Bike Battery Charger Guide: Amps, Volts & Safe Charging

URL: https://electricdirtbikeaustralia.com.au/blog/e-bike-battery-charger-guide-australia/
Published: 2026-10-07

Choosing an e-bike battery charger? Match the voltage and plug, then use a simple formula to estimate charge time. See our three stocked chargers compared.

Covers: How an e-bike battery charger actually works; How long will it take? A worked example; Choosing a charger for e-bike packs: the three we stock; Never use a mismatched charger; Heat, ventilation and overnight charging; Pedal-assist e bike chargers and why ours do not fit; Charger fault or e cycle battery fault?; Chargers and e-bikes for sale: what you pay.

**Does a motor bicycle battery use the same charger as an electric bike?** No. The battery in a petrol bike is a 12V lead-acid or lithium starter battery and needs a different charger from the high-voltage packs on electric motorbikes. Always match voltage and chemistry. We stock chargers for 60V, 72V and 84V e-moto traction packs only.

**Which battery for a electric bike works with the 15A charger, and what does it cost?** Our 15A charger is made for 60V and 72V packs, such as the Sur-Ron OEM 60V 40Ah, the 60V 53Ah pack or the 72V 42Ah upgrade. Pedal-assist packs sit at lower voltages and need their own charger, so check the label before you order anything. The charger is $380. When in doubt, send us a photo of the pack label and the plug.

**Is a battery for an electric bike charged faster with a bigger charger?** Yes, up to the limit of what the battery's BMS and cells accept. A 20A charger can fill a pack sooner than a 10A one, but it also makes more heat. For everyday use, a moderate current is kinder to the cells. Use the high-current setting when time matters, not by default.

**How much do an electric battery for bicycle use and the right charger cost together?** Chargers here run from $240 to $490, with packs listed on the batteries page. Choose the pack first, then the charger. Write down the pack's nominal voltage, full-charge voltage and connector type, then check the charger lists the same. A balanced pair is safer than a mismatched bargain, and it avoids paying twice. If you are buying a pack and charger together, mention both in your enquiry so we c

**Can the same charger look after any bicycle battery?** Not safely. A pedal-assist pack at 48V needs a charger designed for that voltage and cell count, and our 60V and 72V models are not intended for it. Use the supplied charger or ask the maker which replacement matches, and never try to adapt plugs to make a unit fit. A wrong match can damage the pack and may be a fire risk.

**Are wide tyres harder to pedal than normal ones?** Without a motor, yes, because wide knobbly tyres need more effort on pavement. **What are fat tyre bikes actually good for?** A fat wheel bicycle, much like the fat tyre bikes Australia riders buy for the coast, is best on soft or loose surfaces: sand, gravel, snow in colder climates and rough trails. ### Electric Offroad Bike Australia: Range, Torque & Terrain

**How does the battery and motor setup actually work?** A battery pack feeds a controller, which sends current to a motor. **Do the e-bikes you sell come with a local warranty?** The ones we sell do. Adult Ampd Bros e-bikes have a 2-year nationwide warranty for manufacturer faults, and kids models have 1 year. Wear items such as tyres, tubes, brake pads and seats are not covered.

**How will my Ampd Bros bike be delivered?** Adult and kids Ampd Bros bikes are delivered by Toll Ipec with a signature required, so someone needs to be home to receive the bike. Orders over $1,500 qualify for free freight. Read our shipping and returns pages for the full terms before you order, and inspect the bike on arrival.

**What is the e bike price in Australia for the different Ampd Bros models?** Kids models run from $1,599 to $2,399, cruisers and fat tyre bikes from $2,190 to $3,490, and the ACE range up to $4,990. Battery size is the main driver, so compare watt-hours rather than the sticker alone. Our [e-bike price guide](/blog/e-bike-cost-australia-price-guide/) breaks the figures down by type.

**Which model suits a beginner buying their first e-bike?** For a first adult e-bike, the RIPTIDE 3 or Stubbie S3 are approachable and affordable. If you want gears, suspension and longer range, look at the ACE Adventure or ACE PRO. Choose the road-compliant or off-road version to suit where you will ride.
